data.sub: SBI PO interview schedule jari, 01 December se honge shuru.

chat.say: Interview ki date aa gayi, ab taiyari shuru!
Beta ache se taiyari karna, mithai ready rakho.

data.asar: Banking ki taiyari karne walon ke liye bada din.
data.caption: SBI PO interview ka schedule aa chuka hai dost! 📌 Interview 01 December se shuru honge. 📌 Apne documents ready rakho. 📌 Taiyari mein koi kasar mat chhodo. Apne us dost ko tag karo jo banking exam ki taiyari kar raha hai!
